correctness.rationale: Intersection-array recurrence gives exactly 7 sectors; direct factorization of generating polynomials and a 162-coefficient exact rational Bernstein certificate show the bipartition sector strictly dominates other centered sectors for 0<p<1; integral representation transfers the comparison. Strictly positive derivative for F_q on p>=0 proves a unique root in (0,1). Strict endpoint rank and q^-5 asymptotic then follow. verify.py replayed successfully with exact coefficients and finite spectral spot checks. Source graph facts from Exoo--Jajcay 2008 §2.2.3; the rest is established in the package proof.

value.rationale: Determines a natural complete family metric invariant, the exact sharp Schoenberg/Hilbert embedding threshold for every existing symmetric generalized hexagon, plus a one-dimensional endpoint obstruction and asymptotically sharp q^-5 decay. Unlike a finite table or normalization identity, this controls infinitely many incidence metrics and highlights a dimension-sensitive structural phenomenon.
